name: hermes-mods
description: Claude Code mods built for the Hermes project: a status band above the prompt, a house-rules guard, and a diff pane that follows the filetree selection.

plugins.name: hermes-band
plugins.description: A colored band above the prompt: branch, worktree, dirty files another session touched, the context window with a hover bar and two limit gauges, the api/web dev servers with a stop-orphans button, and compact / ship / review buttons.

plugins.name: hermes-guard
plugins.description: Hermes house rules as hooks: stage by path, no code commit without a green health gate, hands-off paths behind /guard unlock, no test skips or deletes, no em-dashes in app source, subagents on Sonnet.

plugins.name: nerd-band
plugins.description: hermes-band for the Nerd Castle knowledge base: branch, worktree, files that are not this session's, the theme / workbench / etsy repos, a pull button when the other station pushed, the theme dev and video preview servers, and the context window.

plugins.name: diff-follow
plugins.description: The desktop app diff pane follows the file selected in the filetree pane: click a changed file there and its diff scrolls into view; /difffollow on | off | scope all | scope uncommitted.

plugins.name: hermes-pr
plugins.description: A card above hermes-band for the branch's pull request: the PR as a link, five status lines (CI with its reason, conflicts with main, behind main, the other open PRs, review) with a check or a cross, and merge / fix PR / close PR buttons stacked on the right; /pr refreshes it, /pr hide|show.
